description: The MaRIUS project publishes weather@home2 regional climate ensembles through CEDA for drought and water-scarcity research. The collection contains HadRM3P fields over the United Kingdom on a rotated 0.22 degree European CORDEX grid. It covers a historical period from 1900 to 2006 and future periods 2020–2049 and 2070–2099 under RCP8.5. The historical set has 100 time series; five future sets sample different sea-surface-temperature warming patterns. NetCDF version 3 files occur at daily, five-day or monthly intervals depending on the variable, with yearly archives and stitching tables linking single-year simulations into sequences. CEDA states public access for registered and unregistered users under the Open Government Licence v3.0, free to reuse with attribution. A limitation is that a 360-day calendar and stitched sequences require careful treatment in infrastructure simulations. The metadata also contains an apparent baseline-year typo, preserved as an unresolved documentation issue. These climate inputs complement the derived MaRIUS runoff products and could support independent water-system stress tests.
